Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject: Post Earnings Call 
This is further to our letters dated May 25, 2026 and June 1, 2026, on the captioned subject.  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the 
audio recording of the Post Earnings (Conference) Call (Group Call) held today, i.e. Wednesday, June 3, 2026, 
has been uploaded on the website of the Company, under the tab “Investor Relations > Disclosures under SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015” at https://www.bata.in/disclosures-
sebi.html   
Further, we write to inform that no UPSI was shared during the said call. List of Management Attendees is same 
as disclosed under our letter dated May 25, 2026 on the captioned subject. 
This is for your information and records. 
 Thanking you, 
 Yours faithfully, 
 For BATA INDIA LIMITED 
 
  
 
 NITIN BAGARIA 
 AVP – Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
